tools.name: ask_vps_prices
tools.description: Answer a plain-language hosting price question ("cheapest 4 GB VPS in Germany under $10", "hetzner vs vultr", "server for a Minecraft Java server") from today’s prices.

tools.name: search_vps_plans
tools.description: Cheapest VPS plans matching a size, budget, provider or location, cheapest first (one per provider unless exactly one provider is given).

tools.name: server_for_app
tools.description: The documented requirements of a self-hosted app or game server (n8n, Nextcloud AIO, Immich, Minecraft Java, Odoo, GitLab, ... 192 apps) and the cheapest plans that meet them.

tools.name: current_vps_offers
tools.description: Introductory and sale prices on the providers’ own pages today, each judged on its first year against the cheapest regular plan with as much memory.
